raw_text: Press Information Bureau Fact Check: A video purportedly showing an Indian Air Force officer making statements against India is FAKE. The video is AI-generated using deepfake technology. The Indian Air Force has confirmed that no such officer exists in its records and the uniform insignia shown in the video contains inaccuracies inconsistent with current IAF dress regulations. Citizens are advised not to share unverified content, especially during the election period. This is part of a broader pattern of foreign-origin disinformation targeting India's defence forces. The matter has been referred to the Cyber Crime Coordination Centre for investigation.
